title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator

Cambridge £31,500 + Excellent Benefits Permanent

Are you an organised finance professional who enjoys working with numbers, systems and people? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and attention to detail really matter?

We're recruiting for an Accounts Administrator to join one of the University of Cambridge Colleges, supporting the management of student and member accounts.

The Opportunity

This is a varied and rewarding finance administration role with responsibility for billing, fee administration, bank reconciliations, payment processing and financial reporting. Working closely with internal departments and external stakeholders, you'll play a key role in ensuring the accurate management of accounts and the delivery of excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities
- Preparing and issuing quarterly bills and invoices.
- Processing high volumes of receipts and payments.
- Managing bank account reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Monitoring outstanding balances and supporting debt collection processes.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and journals.
- Supporting tuition fee administration and reporting.
- Assisting with year-end audit requirements and financial reporting.
- Producing financial analysis and management information.
- Responding to account queries from a diverse range of stakeholders.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and systems.

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience within finance, accounts administration or transactional finance.
- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with finance systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and a professional customer-focused approach.
- Experience within education, membership organisations or professional services environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £31,500
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Private healthcare and dental scheme
- Free onsite lunch
- Employee assistance programme
- Cycle-to-work scheme
- Additional wellbeing and social benefits
- Stable, long-term career opportunity with a respected Cambridge employer.

If you're looking for a finance role that offers variety, responsibility and the chance to work within a highly respected organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact me directly for a confidential discussion.

develop their skills across both accounts payable and accounts
receivable.

Processing supplier invoices and maintaining accurate accounts
payable records

reconciliations

documentation is complete

Responding to supplier and customer queries in a professional
and timely manner
Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end
processes

queries effectively

Recruitment for more information.

haven't heard back within 10 days, please understand that you
have unfortunately been unsuccessful for this position, or the
position has been filled. Please call the office or send an email
to discuss other potential opportunities.

title: HR Coordinator
company: S&B Herba Foods Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: HR Coordinator

Location: Fulbourn, Cambridgeshire CB21 5 ET

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full time, Permanent

Working Hours: Mon - Friday 9am - 5.30pm

About the Company:

S&B Herba Foods Ltd source and import rice and grains (and other raw materials) from across the globe to produce a wide range of ingredients to the specification of UK manufacturers and wholesalers. Our core purpose is to "Feed the nation and be a place where everyone can reach their full potential".

We have just been awarded the Investors In People standard and are embarking on a new era to attain Silver with our ultimate goal Platinum.

In order to do this, we need people that are willing to drive our Goals and Ambitions and continually improve and develop themselves as individuals, with our full support.

Our values are at the heart of everything we do:
- We Before I - We succeed by collaborating and supporting one another
- Proactive - We take ownership, anticipate challenges and find solutions
- Can Do - We approach every task with positivity and determination
- Hungry - We are driven to learn, improve and achieve more every day

If these values resonate with you, we would love to hear from you.

We have been trading for over 100 years and have a great heritage.

Come and join us - it's a great place to work!

About The Role:

We are looking for an enthusiastic, people-focused HR Coordinator to join our team, reporting directly to the HR Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, enjoys variety and wants to build a long-term career in Human Resources whilst helping to create a positive workplace culture.

As our HR Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our people, culture and day-to-day operations. This new and varied position combines HR administration, employee engagement and front-of-house responsibilities. Although based at Cambridge, you will also be supporting our Liverpool site.

You will also contribute to our journey towards achieving Investors in People Silver accreditation, helping to shape initiatives that support employee development and engagement.

Key responsibilities include:
- HR administration: Provide comprehensive support throughout the employee lifecycle and maintain accurate, confidential employee records and documentation.
- Recruitment and onboarding: Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activities.
- Engagement and wellbeing: Coordinate employee engagement and wellbeing initiatives, including projects supporting our Investors in People Silver accreditation.
- Learning and Development Coordination: Support the delivery of the Company's learning and development strategy by coordinating training programmes and courses, maintaining training and skill matrices, tracking completion of mandatory and role-specific training, producing training reports, and promoting continuous professional development opportunities.
- Manager support: Assist managers with HR processes, handling sensitive employee information with discretion and professionalism.
- Continuous improvement: Help improve HR processes and support the HR Manager in terms of the service HR provides to the Company at both sites.
- Front-of-house: Delivering a professional front-of-house reception service, acting as the first point of contact for visitors, employees and external stakeholders. This will include the managing of meeting rooms, post and couriers.

About you:

We are looking for someone who:
- Is passionate about building a career in Human Resources
- Has a university degree in Human Resources or a related discipline, or is keen to pursue an HR degree or professional qualification, such as CIPD, whilst working
- Is highly organised and has excellent attention to detail
- Handles confidential information with integrity and discretion
- Communicates confidently and enjoys working with people at all levels
- Is friendly and professional, creating a positive first impression for visitors
- Is proactive, adaptable and able to manage a varied workload
- Is committed to living our company values every day

What We Offer:
- The opportunity to build a rewarding career in Human Resources
- A varied and rewarding role in which no two days are the same
- The opportunity to contribute to meaningful employee engagement initiatives
- A collaborative, supportive working environment shaped by our core values
- The chance to be part of our journey towards Investors in People Silver accreditation

Benefits:
- 22 days holiday (plus bank holidays) increasing each year by one day until a max of 25 days
- Pension Scheme + Life Assurance
- Income Protection
- Free onsite car parking
- Bike to Work Scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Support to pursue further professional qualifications
- Free rice (quarterly)

Please click the APPLY button and to submit your CV and Cover Letter.

Candidates with experience of: Human Resource Officer, Human Resource Administrator, HR Admin, HR Generalist, HR Officer, HR Specialist, Employee Relations Specialist, Employee Relations Advisor, Employee Relations Manager, HR Business Partner, HR Manager may also be considered for this role.

title: Lettings Administrator
description:

This is a varied and fast-paced role, involving greeting walk-in clients and coordinating appointments and property listings.

To be considered you should have at least 1 years' experience within an administration role and superb attention to detail. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic lettings administrator with a can-do approach and who isn't afraid to get involved in lots of different projects. If this sounds like you, please get in touch today!

Personal specification:
- 1 years' lettings administration experience would be beneficial
- Experience within a fast paced administrative role
- Ideally be ARLA licensed/achieved the NFOPP Technical Award
- Excellent IT skills, including Excel, Power Point, Word, etc.
- Strong organisational skills
- Confident in dealing with clients.

The salary on offer for this lettings administrator role will be between £29,000 and £32,000 depending on experience, plus discretionary bonus. Benefits include 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, Christmas and New Year, pension, on-site gym, and more!

title: Sporting Events Administrator
description:
Sporting Events Administrator

The Sporting Events Team at Alzheimer's Research UK (ARUK) is responsible for securing income from individuals taking on sporting challenges and effectively managing relationships to maximise income.

As Sporting Events Administrator,you will play a significant part in contributing to a high-performing fundraising team. You will work closely with the Sporting Event Managers (SEM) and Sporting Event Officers (SEO) to drive the continued growth of the charity's sporting event fundraising income. You will also be required to show excellent organisation and relationship-building skills to support supporters.

Please note: This role will be known internally as Sporting Events Executive.

Key Responsibilities:

Be the first point of contact for all Sporting Event fundraisers, providing excellent customer service, acknowledging support and increasing long-term loyalty.

Provide effective administrative support to the Sporting Events team, including maintaining accurate records, managing inbox and telephone queries and supporting smooth event delivery.

Provide organised administrative support to SEOs across a range of sporting events and tasks, helping to coordinate day-to-day activity and manage competing priorities.

Fundraising data management including adding new constituents to the fundraising database (Salesforce), ensuring details are accurately recorded and maintained and that supporters are appropriately thanked.

Ensure fundraisers and volunteers have all necessary materials for fundraising initiatives.

Event and Supporter Management

Support the team in managing the sporting events as agreed with the Sporting Events Manager (SEM). Including recruitment of sporting places, recruitment of volunteers, communications plans, event marketing and event attendance.

Working alongside the SEM and the SEO to manage the stewardship of all supporters.

Build and manage relationships with prospective and current sporting fundraising supporters through prompt, helpful, professional and friendly contact.

Proactively contact fundraisers by phone to offer encouragement, guidance and tailored support, helping those who need additional stewardship to build confidence and maximise their fundraising potential.

Taking the opportunity to maximise income and long-term support with every fundraising supporter, suggesting ARUK fundraising products where appropriate.

Schedule and deliver stewardship good luck calls for all portfolio sporting eventers.

Drafting prompt, professional thank you letters and certificates to fundraising supporters.

Managing emails sent to sporting events inbox.

Events Support

Support in the effective delivery of sporting fundraising events for ARUK.

May include relationship management with suppliers and logistics companies.

Attendance of weekend events where necessary.

Knowledge, skills and experience needed:

Experience of working in a customer service role

Use of CRM or database systems

Confident working with computers - good knowledge of Word, Excel, Outlook and databases

Excellent, enthusiastic telephone manner

Ability to build rapport and establish relationships with our supporters quickly and effectively

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Excellent organisational skills

Excellent attention to detail

A professional and hard-working team player

Flexibility to work occasional unsociable hours and willingness to travel independently

Contagious enthusiasm to inspire supporters

Additional Information:

Ways of working:

As part of our Agile ways of working you will be required to work approximately 2 days a week from the office, which is subject to the requirements of the role and the business needs. Flexibility on where you work can be split between working from home and our office.

Roles that are classed as part of the Agile ways of working are not able to claim any costs for Mileage/Travel on Public Transport, Accommodation and/or Meals. This includes when attending the office for various meetings/events.

Our Office: Our office is at 3 Riverside, Granta Park, Great Abington, Cambridge, CB21 6 AD.

Salary: Circa £24,788 per annum, plus benefits

Please download the Vacancy Pack on our website for more information.

The closing date for applications is the 4th October 2026, with interviews being arrange once shortlisting has been completed. Please indicate in your covering letter if you are unable to attend an interview on a certain date. We would encourage you to submit your application at the earliest opportunity, as on occasion we may have to bring forward the interview date and/or the closing date based on the needs of the business. Although a possibility, this will only happen in exceptional circumstances. Please indicate in your covering letter if you are unable to attend an interview on a certain date.

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, particularly from those in the global majority, those with disabilities, men and those from the LGBTQIA+ community. Any offer of employment is however subject to you having the right to work in the UK.

As part of our commitment to being an inclusive employer and ensuring fairness and consistency in our selection process, we will handle your CV and application with the utmost confidentiality. Should you require any adjustments at either the application or interview stage, please contact us via our website.

How to apply: Please create an online account using our Online Recruitment Platform which can be accessed through our Job Vacancies page. You will be able to attach your CV to your application and track the status of your application.

About Alzheimer's Research UK: Alzheimer's Research UK is the UK's leading dementia research charity. Our mission is to accelerate progress towards a cure. Today 1 in 2 people will be impacted by dementia, either through caring for a loved one, developing it themselves or tragically both. But there is hope.

title: CRM Officer
description:
CRM Officer

Hybrid working 3 days onsite

A forward-thinking UK higher-education organisation is looking for a CRM Officer to join a collaborative marketing team and help deliver data-driven, insight-led CRM activity. This is a permanent role with hybrid working (approx. 60% campus-based)

You'll play a key part in planning and delivering CRM communications and campaigns, working across the full lifecycle from audience selection and data preparation through to testing, deployment, performance reporting and continuous optimisation.

What you'll be doing
- Supporting CRM programmes and end-to-end campaign delivery, including planning, testing and implementation
- Preparing and segmenting customer data for targeted marketing activity
- Delivering effective B2 C and B2 B digital CRM communications
- Using large datasets to analyse performance and identify actionable insights
- Building dashboards and reporting to measure and communicate KPIs, evaluate markets/products and drive decision-making
- Working within an agile team, including supporting the introduction of a new system and/or marketing strategy
- Handling complex queries with sound judgement, escalating risks appropriately, and delivering a high standard of customer service

What we're looking for
- Proven experience running CRM campaigns and understanding CRM principles and channels
- Hands-on experience with a CRM platform (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Oracle, or similar)
- Strong analytical skills-able to turn data into clear, actionable insight
- Confidence producing performance reporting and dashboards (KPIs, trends, outcomes)
- Clear communication and strong stakeholder management

CRM Officer

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist
- Location: PE6
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking a Digital Marketing Specialist to drive the day-to-day execution of our marketing plans. This role is pivotal in managing digital campaigns across PPC, SEO, email, and social media, and supports the Head of Marketing in delivering tactical campaigns and coordinating events. The ideal candidate will be a dynamic marketer with a strong background in digital execution and campaign management.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Implement and manage strategic email marketing and PPC campaigns, tracking performance to optimize lead generation.
- Conduct research to identify potential B2 B customers in sectors like agriculture, wastewater, construction, and events.
- Manage the inbound lead pipeline, coordinate with sales for lead transfers, and nurture customers to maximize conversion rates.
- Write and edit high-quality copy for marketing collateral, product applications, and website landing pages.
- Act as the internal "super-user" for the website, managing routine updates, new product uploads, and on-page SEO optimization.
- Serve as the primary liaison for external digital agencies, providing content assets and monitoring deliverables.
- Coordinate the communication of industry events and trade shows, working closely with the Sales team.
- Create and schedule daily social media posts, including basic graphic design.
- Compile regular analytics reports on digital traffic, email engagement, and competitor activity.
- Manage the marketing mailing list to ensure GDPR compliance.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- 3-5 years of broad marketing experience, with a focus on digital execution, content creation, and campaign coordination.
- Proficient in using digital marketing tools like Canva or Adobe Creative Suite, with a preference for candidates with HubSpot experience.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with experience in managing social media and email campaigns.
- Highly organised and reliable, capable of managing multiple tasks and schedules.
- Strong CRM and analytical skills to maintain accurate lead records and produce insightful reports.
- Team player, comfortable collaborating with external stakeholders and willing to travel for trade shows.
- Proactive and mature mindset, able to manage daily operations and make decisions in the absence of the Head of Marketing.
- Background or interest in rainwater harvesting, water treatment, or B2 B environments is advantageous.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Dynamic and supportive work environment.
- Flexible working hours with potential for remote work arrangements.

title: Graduate Communications Officer
description:
Due to exciting expansion, we are representing an organisation recognised as a true pioneer within their sector, at the heart of Cambridge's world-leading ecosystem. They are looking for a confident, personable and highly organised Graduate Communications Officer to support their communications, community engagement and events activity.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate looking to build a career in communications, events and stakeholder engagement. You will work across a varied programme of activity, developing your skills while helping to create an exceptional experience for members, visitors and partners.

As the Graduate Communications Officer, you will be:

Playing an important role in supporting day-to-day communications and community activity. You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation and have the opportunity to take ownership of projects as your experience develops.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting day-to-day communications with members, visitors and external contacts, ensuring interactions are professional, welcoming and engaging.
- Drafting clear and engaging email communications, including newsletters, event invitations and member updates.
- Supporting the planning and delivery of a varied programme of events, from regular community socials to larger conferences.
- Helping to identify and engage industry speakers, coordinating briefings and supporting event logistics.
- Assisting with requests for high-profile tours and conference bookings, helping to ensure an excellent experience for visitors.
- Using CRM systems and platforms such as Eventbrite to manage attendee information and track engagement.
- Supporting post-event reporting and analysis.
- Working closely with Catering, Administration and Marketing teams to ensure events and communications are delivered smoothly.
- Contributing to wider community engagement and communications projects as required.

About You

We are looking for a graduate with excellent communication skills, a professional approach and a genuine interest in working with people.

As the Graduate Communications Officer you will have:
- A degree or equivalent qualification.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce polished written content.
- A friendly, confident and professional manner.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
- An interest in communications, events, community engagement or marketing.
- Confidence using digital platforms and an ability to learn new systems quickly.
- The ability to work collaboratively while also taking initiative and ownership of tasks.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate looking to build a career in communications so please apply if you think this is the role for you.

By applying for this Graduate Communications Officer role, you are agreeing to your CV being held on our database, stored confidentially and securely. Your CV details will be used and kept only to provide recruitment services from us. We will only send your details to clients once discussed with you and your data will not be shared with any other third party. You can ask for the deletion or correction of your data, or to opt out of this service at any point by informing Exact Sourcing.

We very much look forward to hearing from you and will be reviewing all applications over the next 2 to 3 weeks. If you are selected, we will be in contact and if not, we will be keeping your details on file for any future vacancies.

Exact Sourcing is an equal opportunities employment agency.

title: Owned Brand Manager
description:
We're looking for an experienced Owned Brand Manager to join our growing commercial team and take responsibility for the development, performance and long-term strategy of our owned brands. You'll be accountable for delivering profitable growth through compelling product ranges, clear brand positioning and excellent cross-functional collaboration across design, supply chain, merchandising, marketing and retail.

What you'll do:
- Own the end-to-end brand roadmap, from concept and product development through to launch, lifecycle management and rationalisation.
- Develop and maintain strong brand positioning and value propositions that resonate with our target customers and support channel strategies (stores, online and wholesale where applicable).
- Translate market insights, customer feedback and commercial data into actionable product specifications, features and price architecture.
- Work closely with design and product teams to brief, approve and iterate ranges, ensuring consistency of quality, fit for purpose specification and cost targets.
- Partner with supply chain and buying to set order plans, margin targets and inventory strategies that balance availability and working capital.
- Develop seasonal range plans, promotional calendars and NPD pipelines that drive sales and margin improvements.
- Liaise with marketing and visual teams to create impactful launch packs, product copy, imagery and in-store merchandising tools.
- Monitor brand and SKU performance, producing regular commercial reviews and taking timely corrective action where required.
- Manage stakeholder relationships and influence senior decision making through clear commercial rationale and reporting.
- Champion sustainability and cost-efficiency opportunities in product design and sourcing.

What we're dreaming of seeing:

We want someone who combines strong commercial acumen with creative flair and excellent project management. You'll be data-driven, customer-focused and able to balance short-term trading needs with long-term brand building.
- Proven experience in brand, product or range management, ideally within furniture, homewares, sleep or fast-moving retail categories.
- Demonstrable track record of delivering profitable NPD and range performance against sales and margin targets.
- Strong numeracy and commercial analysis skills, able to interpret sales, margin and inventory metrics.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to lead cross-functional projects.
- Knowledge of product specification, costing and supply chain processes, with experience of working alongside offshore suppliers an advantage.
- Organised, proactive and able to prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced retail environment.
- Degree or equivalent experience in marketing, business, product design or a relevant discipline is desirable.

The best sleep is when we feel comfortable

We believe in creating a workplace where everyone can be their authentic self. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and treat all candidates with respect. If you're passionate about building brands and delivering great customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

The cool side of the pillow (our benefits):

We offer a competitive package and a range of colleague benefits to support your wellbeing, career and financial security:
- Competitive base salary with role appropriate bonus and performance incentives.
- Colleague discount across our product ranges.
- Health and wellbeing support including employee assistance services and cash-back options for selected therapies.
- Financial: Group Income Protection and pension scheme provided by Legal & General.
- Leave: generous annual leave entitlement with buy & sell flexibility and enhanced parental leave.
- Your Career: learning and development programmes and access to internal progression opportunities.
- Group Life Assurance of 2x annual salary and ongoing recognition schemes.

( qualifying periods apply)
